mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_event_outbox (event_id, org_id, instance_id, sequence_no, category, business_id, definition_id, event_type, event_time, payload, status, retry_count, total_failures, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{orgId}, #{instanceId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{category}, #{businessId}, #{definitionId}, #{eventType}, #{eventTime}, #{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{totalFailures}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT e.event_id, e.event_type, e.payload FROM flow_event_outbox e WHERE ((e.status = 'PENDING' AND e.next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (e.status = 'PROCESSING' AND e.lease_until <= #{now})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM flow_event_outbox p WHERE p.instance_id = e.instance_id AND p.sequence_no < e.sequence_no AND p.status <> 'DELIVERED') ORDER BY e.next_attempt_at, e.event_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_event_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_token = #{token}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE flow_event_outbox SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{token} AND lease_until > #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT retry_count FROM flow_event_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{token} AND lease_until > #{now} FOR UPDATE

SELECT event_id, org_id, instance_id, category, event_type, status, retry_count, last_error, next_attempt_at FROM flow_event_outbox WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PAUSED') AND last_error IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at, event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_event_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_attempt_at = #{now} WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PAUSED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM flow_event_outbox WHERE status = 'DELIVERED' AND delivered_at < #{cutoff}
